decision_rules.action: Use farm_state_get, farm_profile, farm_state_set, and farm_profile_start in sequence.
decision_rules.condition: Farm status and state indicate the profile is stopped or idle and no container/registry error is present.

decision_rules.action: Require container-registry-mcp provider before attempting further farm profile start.
decision_rules.condition: Failure involves container image pull, registry authentication, or missing container-registry-mcp capability.

requires.name: container-registry-mcp
requires.purpose: Handle container registry and image pull operations needed for farm profile start.

description: Recover AMT re-expansion farm profile start failures by reading farm posture, profile, shared state, and result records before retrying the registered farm_profile_start tool, using only registered farm providers and ordinary reasoning.

heuristics.description: Inspect farm_status and farm_profiles, then farm_state_get and farm_result.
heuristics.name: Error mentions farm 'default', /profiles/profile_#/start, or http #: [object object]
heuristics.when_to_apply: Error mentions farm 'default', /profiles/profile_#/start, or http #: [object object]

heuristics.description: Use farm_profile or farm_state_set to reconcile state, then retry farm_profile_start.
heuristics.name: Farm status or state shows paused, stopped, or mismatched profile
heuristics.when_to_apply: Farm status or state shows paused, stopped, or mismatched profile

heuristics.description: Avoid blind retries; route to container-registry-mcp capability if not available.
heuristics.name: Error suggests container, registry, or image pull problem
heuristics.when_to_apply: Error suggests container, registry, or image pull problem

name: Farm Profile Start Failure Recovery

principles.rationale: Check farm_status, farm_profiles, farm_state_get, and farm_result before invoking farm_profile_start.
Confirm the target profile identifier and shared state before retrying post /profiles/profile_#/start.
Use farm_profile_stop, farm_profile_pause, or farm_state_set only after confirming the current state.
